title: Swap bromine for oxygen
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: In the substitution pathway, hydroxide attacks the primary carbon and bromide leaves. The carbon skeleton stays in place while Br is replaced by OH.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of bromoethane under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Bromoethane is treated with aqueous hydroxide. Which major organic product forms after workup? In the substitution pathway, hydroxide attacks the primary carbon and bromide leaves. The carbon skeleton stays in place while Br is replaced by OH.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
